First Quarter Results | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings Login Register First Quarter Results AI Summary Close X Seraphim Space's NAV rose 4.2% to £734.2m for the three months to 30 September 2026, driven by a 10.4% increase in portfolio valuation to £668.6m and NAV per ordinary share up 5.1% to 252.73p; cash reserves declined 19.9% to £122.5m with a further £40.2m of potential listed liquidity, and the Company deployed £43.6m in new and follow-on investments. Portfolio concentration remains high with ICEYE at 54.0% of NAV and Xona at 10.4% (post-period Series D valuing Xona at $2.5bn); a performance fee liability of £59.1m (c.8% of NAV) and a wider ordinary share discount of -24.5% (‑260bps) are notable headwinds.
